That run puts pressure on the visitors to find a more secure defensive approach, but they cannot afford to become so cautious that they lose their attacking threat. Their 15 goals suggest they can still trouble opponents, and Botoşani’s record of conceding 20 league goals offers some encouragement. Even so, Voluntari will need a marked [...] Botoşani are the logical favourites because they have more points, a steadier home record and an opponent that has lost every league away match so far. Their recent form is far from convincing, and the head-to-head record favours Voluntari, but the visitors’ 11 defeats and 33 goals conceded underline the scale of their problems. The most reasonable main prediction is a home win, with Botoşani expected to make their home advantage count. [...] The most recent meeting between these sides finished 2–2, both in all competitions and in Liga 1. That draw is a reminder that the matchup can be closely contested, regardless of the teams’ current standings. Across the last five meetings in all competitions, Botoşani have not recorded a win: three matches ended level and Voluntari won twice. The historical balance therefore gives the visitors some reason for confidence, even if their present away form is a major obstacle.
